feeds.title: London Playwrights Blog
feeds.description: London Playwrights was started in 2013 as a resource for emerging playwrights. We aim to bring together the latest opportunities, best resources, and good advice in one place. In 2015, the team formed London Playwrights' Workshop Ltd as a non-profit company to help expand this support for writers through workshops, events, and expanded online resources.

feeds.title: NYC Playwrights
feeds.description: NYCPlaywrights provides script submission opportunities and other theatre resources and information. Playwriting format and template available. NYCPlaywrights provides playwright submission opportunities; discounts; free shows and other theatre items for New York City and the world.

feeds.title: Adam Szymkowicz
feeds.description: Adam Szymkowicz's blog is a collection of all interviews he conducted with playwrights. He has interviewed over 1000 playwrights on his blog. ADAM SZYMKOWICZ's plays have been produced throughout the U.S and in Canada, England, The Netherlands, New Zealand, Australia, Germany, Greece, Mexico, Turkey, South Korea, Thailand, Sweden, Slovenia and Lithuania.

feeds.title: Play Submissions Helper Blog
feeds.description: Discover Insane compendium of 400+ play submissions opportunities, all in one place. Stay up to date with all our latest updates as they happen so that you'll never miss a play submission opportunity. Think of us as your personal submissions directory, we take out all of the hard work of identifying the newest and best opportunities for you to submit your masterpiece to. Plus instead of random outdated submission opportunities, you're getting at least 400+ of the newest and most relevant play submission opportunities at any time, located all over the world.

feeds.title: LAFPI Blog
feeds.description: Find articles with information on LAFPI, famous female playwrights, play submissions and more. The Los Angeles Female Playwrights Initiative is an LA-based movement working to ensure that women+ playwrights are fairly represented on local stages, and beyond.

feeds.title: Plan-B Theatre Blog
feeds.description: We share stories with a local point-of-view as well as global stories from a local perspective. Plan-B develops and produces unique and socially conscious theatre created by Utah playwrights. Since 1991, we have developed and produced unique and socially conscious theatre created by Utah playwrights. We are the first professional arts organization in Utah history led by an artist of color. We are the only professional arts organization in Utah led by a majority-POC board.

feeds.title: Player Playwrights Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blogs for upcoming meets, workshops, shows, schedules, new plays and more. Player Playwrights, which is still run by its actor and playwright members, continues to bring together professional actors and writers with weekly play readings, actor and writer workshops, plus guest speaker events for its members.

feeds.title: Dan Rebellato News
feeds.description: Know what's happening in Dan's life, new books, upcoming plays, shows and more. Dan Rebellato is a world-renowned playwright, has written multiple books, plays and is Professor of Contemporary Theatre (and currently Head of Department) at Royal Holloway, University of London.

feeds.title: The Playwrights Union
feeds.description: Get regular news and updates from the community along with writers stories. Playwrights Union is an inclusive group of writers that actively fosters growth for LA-based playwrights and provides a supportive artistic community.

feeds.title: Duane Kelly Blog
feeds.description: Duane Kelly is the author of eleven full-length plays. In 2016 he co-founded Red Rover Theatre Company, which performs new plays in Seattle's fringe venues. Duane is a member of the Dramatists Guild of America and for eight years served as the Guild's regional representative for Washington state. Check out his musings, and tips on playwriting, stories and more!

feeds.title: Workshop West Playwrights' Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with Workshop West Playwrights' Theatre news. Get info about upcoming shows, workshops, play development, and more. We are a professional theatre company dedicated to the development, production, promotion, and presentation of Canadian playwrights and new Canadian works.

feeds.title: Bunbury Banter's Young Playwrights Programme Blog
feeds.description: Find the resources to help playwrights, their musings, experiences, etc. Bunbury Banter's Young Playwrights Programme offers young writers from Dumfries and Galloway the opportunity to develop their work within the theatrical medium, supported and guided by playwrights and other theatre creatives from across the UK.

feeds.title: Playwrights' Workshop Montréal » Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from PWM and the team about various projects, plays, artists and more. Playwrights' Workshop Montréal's (PWM) is a nationally-mandated theatre development centre based in Montréal. PWM's mission is to collaborate with artists in the development of new works of theatre and performance.

feeds.title: Donna Hoke Blog
feeds.description: Read more about Donna's life, career, new plays, reviews and more. Playwright and screenwriter Donna Hoke's work has been seen in 47 states and on five continents, including at Barrington Stage, Barrow Group, Celebration Theatre, Gulfshore Theatre, Queens Theatre, The Road, Writers Theatre New Jersey, Phoenix Theatre and more.

feeds.title: Boldtext Playwrights » Blog
feeds.description: For lots more information about what we do, how we do it, and what people say about it, follow our blog. We are a collective of eight professional writers from the West Midlands who came together in 2013 to create new work that celebrates and reflects our regtion. So far this has included partnerships with the Birmingham Repertory Theatre, WMP Heritage, Culture Central and Birmingham Museums Trust.

feeds.title: Kari Bentley-Quinn Playwright News
feeds.description: Know about The latest goings-on in Kari's career to date. Kari Bentley-Quinn is a playwright based in New York City, originally from Stratford, CT. Her plays have been presented at or developed with Lark Play Development Center, Lesser America, Halcyon Theatre, Animus Theatre Company, Theatre of NOTE and more.

feeds.title: San Diego Playwrights
feeds.description: We are San Diego Playwrights. We promote San Diego playwrights and the theatres and organizations that support them. We engage the community in the process of getting local playwrights produced in San Diego.

feeds.title: Spokane Playwrights Laboratory Blog
feeds.description: We provide you with time, resources, and professional expertise in our blog. Spokane Playwrights Laboratory exists to help local writers create original plays. We are here to help you get your script ready to submit to local or professional theatres. Through our workshop process, we give you a competitive edge.

feeds.title: Rachel Bykowski Blog
feeds.description: I write plays. I tell stories. I create content. I vent. I offer advice. I hope people will learn from my mistakes. I write to explore the many facets of my identity and raise awareness to social issues. Since 2006, I have been writing plays that explore middle class America, matriarchies, privilege, gender roles, and how women contribute to the legacies of their families.

feeds.title: Theatre Three » Playwrights
feeds.description: Now entering its 60th season, Theatre Three (T3) was founded by Norma Young, Jac Alder, Esther Ragland, and Roy Dracup in 1961. Theatre Three illuminates the human experience with exemplary, intimate theatrical productions. Learn more about playwriting, tips and tricks, advice from our experts and more!

feeds.title: Dramatics » Playwrights
feeds.description: We are clarifying your vision with our playwriting tips and experiences. Dramatics is the online home of #ThespianNation. As the official student website of the International Thespian Society (ITS) - the honor society for middle and high school theatre students - Dramatics.org is your guide to embracing your passion, honing your craft, and enjoying all things theatre.

feeds.title: Script Magazine » Playwright
feeds.description: Script has been the leading source for information on the craft and business of writing for film and television since 1995. With inside information, articles written by working writers and filmmakers, and in-depth interviews, Script is the resource on every scriptwriter's must-read list. Know more about playwriting, tips and advice and more from industry experts.

feeds.title: Young Playwrights' Theater Blog
feeds.description: This blog captures the stories, news, and latest happenings at Young Playwrights' Theater. Young Playwrights Theater (YPT) is an arts education non-profit and producing theater in Washington, DC. YPT believes that creative expression and theater are valuable tools for the education, enrichment and self-actualization of young people.

feeds.title: The Lark Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for community updates, guides for playwrights, interviews with artists, writers, etc. Founded in 1994, The Lark was an international theater laboratory, based in New York City, dedicated to empowering playwrights by providing transformative support.
